decision_rule: tools/inference_server_bench.py: not clearly better at N=8 => do not wire in
verdict: SERVER LOSES. The 4-game wall win is model-load amortisation only (1 load vs 8); by 24 games stage 1 is ahead on wall too. IPC round trip + 2ms linger exceeds the cross-worker batching gain because 8 workers already saturate the GPU. Do not wire into generation.
residual_benefit: 1 model resident in VRAM instead of 8; binds only if more workers than memory allows are wanted, and 8 is the measured throughput optimum.
